entries.name: Buck converter topology
entries.summary: A switching converter arrangement used to produce a lower DC output from its input under the documented operating conditions.

entries.name: Boost converter topology
entries.summary: A switching converter arrangement used to obtain a higher DC output from its documented input range.

entries.name: Inverting buck-boost topology
entries.summary: A buck-boost arrangement whose output polarity is opposite to its defined input reference.

entries.name: Four-switch buck-boost topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting conversion arrangement with switching legs that support documented buck and boost operation.

entries.name: SEPIC converter topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting conversion topology using its documented inductive and series-capacitor energy-transfer arrangement.

entries.name: Cuk converter topology
entries.summary: An inverting conversion topology using a capacitor as part of the energy-transfer path between inductive stages.

entries.name: Zeta converter topology
entries.summary: A non-inverting converter arrangement using its documented inductive and capacitive transfer circuit.

entries.name: Flyback converter topology
entries.summary: A conversion arrangement that uses coupled magnetic energy storage and transfers energy through the documented switching sequence.

entries.name: Forward converter topology
entries.summary: A conversion topology transferring power through coupled windings during the documented primary conduction interval.

entries.name: Active-clamp forward topology
entries.summary: A forward converter arrangement with an actively controlled clamp/reset circuit.

entries.name: Push-pull converter topology
entries.summary: A converter arrangement driving two primary paths alternately through the documented coupled winding.

entries.name: Half-bridge DC converter topology
entries.summary: A DC conversion stage using one switching leg and the documented magnetic/secondary circuit.

entries.name: Full-bridge DC converter topology
entries.summary: A DC conversion stage using two switching legs to apply the documented waveform to a magnetic primary.

entries.name: Phase-shifted full-bridge topology
entries.summary: A full-bridge conversion arrangement controlled through the documented relative switching-leg phase shift.

entries.name: LLC resonant converter topology
entries.summary: A converter arrangement using the documented resonant inductive/capacitive network and magnetic transfer path.

entries.name: Dual-active-bridge topology
entries.summary: A conversion stage with controlled bridges on both sides of a coupled magnetic link.

entries.name: Single-phase voltage-source inverter
entries.summary: A switching bridge that forms a documented single-phase AC output from a DC-link source.

entries.name: Three-phase voltage-source inverter
entries.summary: A three-leg bridge producing the documented three-phase output from a DC-link source.

entries.name: Neutral-point-clamped inverter
entries.summary: A multilevel switching arrangement using the documented split DC link and neutral-point clamping paths.

entries.name: Active front-end rectifier
entries.summary: An actively switched AC/DC stage using a documented current-control and DC-link regulation arrangement.

entries.name: Battery fuel gauge

entries.name: Active battery cell balancer

entries.name: Battery pack monitor

entries.name: Battery precharge circuit

entries.name: Battery pack current measurement

entries.summary: A solar power optimiser uses conversion and control at a selected module or input level.

entries.name: Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function
aliases: Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function functional block
Photovoltaic rapid shutdown function schematic reference
entries.summary: Rapid shutdown is a defined solar-system function that changes specified circuit conditions following a shutdown command.

entries.name: Fixed-speed wind turbine generator (Type 1)
entries.summary: A wind turbine whose squirrel-cage induction generator connects to the network directly, running at nearly constant speed.

entries.name: Variable-slip wind turbine generator (Type 2)
entries.summary: A wind turbine using a wound-rotor induction generator with controlled external rotor resistance to widen the slip range.

entries.name: Doubly-fed induction generator
entries.summary: A wound-rotor induction generator with the stator on the network and the rotor fed through a back-to-back converter sized for slip power.

entries.name: Full-converter wind turbine generator (Type 4)
entries.summary: A wind turbine whose entire generator output passes through a full-rated back-to-back converter before reaching the network.

entries.name: Three-phase induction generator
entries.summary: A squirrel-cage asynchronous machine driven above synchronous speed so that it delivers power into a three-phase network.

entries.name: Single-phase synchronous generator
entries.summary: A synchronous alternator delivering a single-phase output, common on small portable and standby generating sets.

entries.name: Synchronous generator with brushless exciter
entries.summary: A synchronous alternator shown with its exciter machine and rotating rectifier, as used on most generating sets.

entries.summary: IEEE-oriented library form of a three-phase synchronous generator with permanent-magnet excitation, with reading notes.

symbolVariant.reference: Autodesk publishes this block under its IEEE Symbol Preview for generators. The counterpart is the matching functional concept; no equivalence of every detailed standard graphic is asserted.

entries.name: Diesel generator set
entries.summary: A compression-ignition engine coupled to an alternator, shown as a source on microgrid and standby power single-line diagrams.

entries.name: Gas engine generator set
entries.summary: A spark-ignited reciprocating engine on natural gas, biogas or LPG driving an alternator, shown as a generating source.

entries.name: Gas turbine generator
entries.summary: A combustion gas turbine coupled to a synchronous generator, often through a gearbox, shown as a generating unit.

entries.name: Hydro turbine generator
entries.summary: A water turbine driving a generator, used for mini and micro hydro sources within microgrids and remote supplies.

entries.name: Fuel cell
entries.summary: An electrochemical source that converts hydrogen or another fuel directly into DC electricity, usually followed by a converter.

entries.name: Hydrogen electrolyser
entries.summary: A DC load that splits water into hydrogen and oxygen, supplied through a rectifier as a controllable sink in a microgrid.

entries.name: Flywheel energy storage
entries.summary: A rotating mass coupled to a motor-generator and converter that stores energy kinetically for short, high-power bursts.

entries.name: Supercapacitor bank
entries.summary: A series-parallel array of double-layer capacitor cells storing energy for very fast, short-duration power delivery.

entries.name: Single battery cell
entries.summary: One electrochemical cell drawn as a single long plate and short plate pair, marking cell-level voltage and polarity.

entries.name: Battery string
entries.summary: A series connection of cells or modules reaching the system DC voltage, often with its own fuse or breaker and monitoring.

entries.name: Battery rack
entries.summary: A rack of series-connected battery modules with its own switchgear and battery management unit, forming one DC source.

entries.name: Battery energy storage system
entries.summary: A complete battery plant block combining batteries, power conversion and controls, shown as one source or sink on an SLD.

entries.name: Centre-tapped battery bank
entries.summary: A battery bank with a mid-point connection that provides positive and negative rails about a common centre point.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE battery symbol
entries.summary: IEEE-style multi-cell battery drawn as alternating long and short plates, with polarity marked, for American drawing sets.

symbolVariant.form: IEEE-style multi-cell battery with omitted-cell gap
symbolVariant.reference: Form described from IEEE/ANSI 315 drawing practice as publicly summarised; no certified reproduction of the standard graphic is asserted.

entries.name: Battery power conversion system
entries.summary: The bidirectional inverter stage of a battery plant that charges and discharges the DC battery from the AC network.

entries.name: Float and boost battery charger
entries.summary: A rectifier charger that holds a stationary battery at float voltage and can apply a higher boost or equalise voltage.

entries.name: Thyristor phase-controlled rectifier
entries.summary: An AC-to-DC converter using thyristors fired at a controlled angle to set its DC output voltage.

entries.name: Twelve-pulse rectifier
entries.summary: Two six-pulse bridges fed from star and delta transformer windings 30 degrees apart, cancelling the lowest harmonics.

entries.name: Grid-forming inverter
entries.summary: An inverter controlled as a voltage source that sets its own voltage and frequency, able to energise and hold up an island.

entries.name: Grid-following inverter
entries.summary: An inverter that tracks an existing network voltage with a phase-locked loop and injects controlled current into it.

entries.name: Hybrid inverter
entries.summary: A single inverter with PV, battery and AC ports, combining MPPT charging, battery inversion and backup output.

entries.name: Bidirectional inverter-charger
entries.summary: A battery converter that charges from an AC source and inverts back to AC, with an internal transfer relay for the load.

entries.name: PV string inverter
entries.summary: A solar inverter connecting a small number of PV strings directly, each group tracked by its own MPPT input.

entries.name: PV central inverter
entries.summary: A large solar inverter fed from DC combiner boxes, usually paired with its own medium-voltage transformer.

entries.name: PV microinverter
entries.summary: A small inverter attached to one or two PV modules, converting to AC at the module and paralleling on an AC trunk cable.

entries.name: Bidirectional DC-to-DC converter
entries.summary: A DC/DC stage that can pass power in either direction, linking a battery or supercapacitor to a DC bus.

entries.name: Isolated DC-to-DC converter
entries.summary: A DC/DC converter with an internal high-frequency transformer that separates input and output galvanically.

entries.name: Static frequency converter
entries.summary: A rectifier and inverter in one unit that converts AC at one frequency to AC at another, such as 50 Hz to 60 Hz.

entries.name: Motor-generator set
entries.summary: A motor mechanically coupled to a generator, used to isolate, change frequency or convert between AC and DC.

entries.name: Static transfer switch
entries.summary: A thyristor-based switch that transfers a load between two synchronised sources within a quarter cycle.

entries.name: Automatic transfer switch
entries.summary: A mechanically switched changeover device that automatically moves a load from a failed normal source to an alternate source.

entries.name: Manual transfer switch
entries.summary: An operator-moved changeover switch that selects which of two sources supplies a load, with an off position between them.

entries.name: Closed-transition transfer switch
entries.summary: A transfer switch that briefly parallels two synchronised sources so the load moves without interruption.

entries.name: Bypass-isolation transfer switch
entries.summary: An automatic transfer switch paired with a manual bypass switch so the ATS can be isolated for maintenance without losing the load.

entries.name: Online double-conversion UPS
entries.summary: A UPS whose rectifier and inverter carry the load continuously, with the battery on the DC link and a static bypass.

entries.name: Line-interactive UPS
entries.summary: A UPS that passes mains to the load through a voltage-correcting stage and switches to its bidirectional inverter on failure.

entries.name: Offline standby UPS
entries.summary: A UPS that passes raw mains straight to the load and starts its inverter only when mains is lost.

entries.name: Rotary UPS
entries.summary: A UPS built around a rotating synchronous machine with kinetic storage, often coupled to a diesel engine for long backup.

entries.name: UPS maintenance bypass
entries.summary: An arrangement of interlocked switches that routes the load around a UPS so the UPS can be isolated for work.

entries.name: Static var compensator
entries.summary: A shunt reactive power compensator built from thyristor-controlled reactors, thyristor-switched capacitors and filters.

entries.name: Thyristor-controlled reactor
entries.summary: A shunt reactor in series with anti-parallel thyristors whose firing angle sets the reactive power absorbed.

entries.name: Thyristor-switched capacitor
entries.summary: A capacitor bank switched in or out at current zero by anti-parallel thyristors, giving fast stepwise reactive support.

entries.name: Static synchronous compensator
entries.summary: A voltage-source converter in shunt that injects or absorbs reactive current to support voltage, independent of system voltage.

entries.name: Synchronous condenser
entries.summary: An unloaded synchronous machine on the network that supplies reactive power, inertia and short-circuit strength.

entries.name: Single-tuned harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt series-LC branch tuned near one harmonic order to sink that harmonic current from the network.

entries.name: Damped high-pass harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt filter with a resistor across its reactor, giving low impedance over a broad band of higher harmonics.

entries.name: Active harmonic filter
entries.summary: A shunt converter that measures load harmonics and injects opposing currents to cancel them at the connection point.

entries.name: Detuned capacitor bank
entries.summary: Power factor correction capacitors with series reactors that tune each step below the lowest significant harmonic.

entries.name: Dynamic voltage restorer
entries.summary: A series converter that injects a corrective voltage through a transformer to ride a sensitive load through voltage sags.

entries.name: Point of common coupling
entries.summary: A marker on a single-line diagram identifying where a customer installation or microgrid meets the public network.

entries.name: Utility grid connection
entries.summary: The symbol for the external utility network as a supply source at the top of a single-line diagram.

entries.name: Grid equivalent source
entries.summary: A voltage source behind an impedance used in study diagrams to represent the external network at a defined fault level.

entries.name: Microgrid interconnection switch
entries.summary: The switching device that separates a microgrid from the utility for islanding and reconnects it after synchronising.

entries.name: Resistive load bank
entries.summary: A bank of switched resistive elements used to apply a controllable test load to generators, UPS or battery systems.

entries.name: Resistive-reactive load bank
entries.summary: A test load bank combining resistive and inductive steps to load a generator at its rated power factor.

entries.name: Neutral earthing resistor
entries.summary: A resistor between a transformer or generator neutral and earth that limits earth-fault current to a set value.

entries.name: Arc suppression coil
entries.summary: An adjustable reactor between neutral and earth tuned to cancel the network capacitive earth-fault current.

entries.name: Microgrid controller
entries.summary: The supervisory controller that dispatches sources, storage and loads and manages islanding and reconnection of a microgrid.

entries.name: Genset controller
entries.summary: The device controller that starts, protects and synchronises a generating set and controls its breaker.

entries.name: Power plant controller
entries.summary: The plant-level controller that measures at the connection point and sets inverter or turbine outputs to meet grid requirements.

entries.name: Dump load controller
entries.summary: A controller that diverts surplus generation into a resistive dump load to hold frequency or voltage in a small isolated system.

entries.name: Split-phase inverter
entries.summary: An inverter with two 180-degree displaced outputs and a neutral, supplying 120/240 V split-phase installations.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE Single-phase AC source form
entries.summary: IEEE-library form of single-phase ac source: a single-phase AC source identifies a documented source boundary in a schematic or SLD.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE Three-phase AC source form
entries.summary: IEEE-library form of three-phase ac source: a three-phase AC source identifies a documented three-phase supply boundary.

symbolVariant.reference: Autodesk IEEE Symbol Preview: Miscellaneous, block HPW1_3PH. Matching functional counterpart linked separately. Independently drawn educational geometry; not a certified IEEE glyph or database identifier.

entries.name: ANSI/IEEE Photovoltaic generator form

entries.name: Microgrid grid-connected mode coordinator
entries.summary: Coordinates the defined source and load controls while the utility interconnection is established.

entries.name: Microgrid intentional-island request interface
entries.summary: Receives the authorized request to prepare the defined microgrid for separation from the utility.

entries.name: Microgrid unintentional-island response coordinator
entries.summary: Applies the documented control response to an externally initiated loss of utility connection.

entries.name: Microgrid islanded mode coordinator
entries.summary: Coordinates the defined local voltage, frequency and resource controls after the island state is established.

entries.name: Microgrid reconnect preparation block
entries.summary: Checks the defined prerequisites before attempting the selected return to grid connection.

entries.name: Microgrid transition-state indication
entries.summary: Reports that the controller is between its defined stable operating modes.

entries.name: Microgrid mode-command authority selector
entries.summary: Selects the authorized origin of operating-mode requests according to the control philosophy.

entries.name: Microgrid operating-mode mismatch alarm
entries.summary: Detects disagreement between the requested mode and the established topology or resource state.

entries.name: Microgrid controller manual-mode interface
entries.summary: Identifies the documented manual control authority and its assigned automatic restraints.

entries.name: Microgrid automatic-mode enable
entries.summary: Permits the defined automatic coordination when its required authority and health inputs are satisfied.

entries.name: Microgrid resource-role assignment
entries.summary: Assigns the selected resources to their documented grid-forming or following control roles.

entries.name: Microgrid grid-forming reference selection
entries.summary: Selects the available source assigned to establish the island voltage and frequency reference.

entries.name: Microgrid mode-change rejection indication
entries.summary: Reports that a requested operating-mode change failed its defined entry conditions.

entries.name: Microgrid transition-abort interface
entries.summary: Identifies the documented request to abandon an incomplete operating-mode transition.

entries.name: Microgrid utility-outage persistence gate
entries.summary: Uses the defined persistence condition when distinguishing a temporary utility disturbance from an unavailable source.

entries.name: Microgrid utility-return qualification
entries.summary: Qualifies the utility restoration condition before enabling the assigned reconnect process.

entries.name: Microgrid operating-mode history recorder
entries.summary: Associates confirmed mode changes with their initiating cause and recorded time.

entries.name: Microgrid emergency operating-state interface
entries.summary: Coordinates the separately defined emergency control state and its assigned resource outputs.

entries.name: Microgrid PCC live-side voltage selector
entries.summary: Identifies the utility-side voltage reference supplied to the PCC synchronising function.

entries.name: Microgrid PCC island-side voltage selector
entries.summary: Identifies the island-side voltage reference supplied to the PCC synchronising function.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising frequency-error block
entries.summary: Calculates the defined frequency difference across the assigned open interconnection breaker.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising phase-error block
entries.summary: Calculates the defined phase-angle difference between the two assigned voltage references.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising voltage-error block
entries.summary: Calculates the defined voltage-magnitude mismatch between the interconnection sides.

entries.name: Microgrid frequency-match adjustment output
entries.summary: Requests the assigned grid-forming source adjustment used to reduce the synchronising frequency error.

entries.name: Microgrid voltage-match adjustment output
entries.summary: Requests the assigned source-voltage adjustment used by the reconnection control.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising close-permissive block
entries.summary: Combines the specified synchronising conditions into the assigned breaker-closing permission.

entries.name: Microgrid breaker closing-time compensation
entries.summary: Accounts for the defined breaker operating-time model in its assigned synchronising command.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising timeout indication
entries.summary: Reports that the assigned synchronising process did not complete within its defined interval.

entries.name: Microgrid dead-island utility-reconnect interface
entries.summary: Distinguishes the documented dead-island energization case from live-island synchronised reconnection.

entries.name: Microgrid dead-utility island-close restraint
entries.summary: Identifies the specified restraint on connecting an energized island to an unavailable utility circuit.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising measurement-quality gate
entries.summary: Restrains the assigned closing path when a required synchronising input is invalid.

entries.name: Microgrid multiple-PCC synchronising selection
entries.summary: Selects the named interconnection point and voltage references for the assigned synchronising transaction.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising source-ownership interface
entries.summary: Assigns the resource controller allowed to adjust the island reference during synchronising.

entries.name: Microgrid close-command confirmation interface
entries.summary: Compares the issued PCC closing request with its assigned breaker feedback.

entries.name: Microgrid failed-reconnect restraint
entries.summary: Blocks repeated reconnect attempts according to the documented failure and reset policy.

entries.name: Microgrid synchronising cancellation interface
entries.summary: Withdraws the defined synchronising request when its authorized cancellation condition occurs.

entries.name: Microgrid PCC import-limit controller
entries.summary: Requests resource adjustments to keep the measured utility import within the assigned operating limit.

entries.name: Microgrid PCC export-limit controller
entries.summary: Requests resource adjustments when measured export approaches the assigned connection limit.

entries.name: Microgrid zero-interchange target block
entries.summary: Forms the documented target for balancing local demand and generation at the PCC.

entries.name: Microgrid site active-power setpoint allocator
entries.summary: Distributes the assigned site power target among resources with available control capacity.

entries.name: Microgrid available-generation capacity estimator
entries.summary: Combines declared resource availability and power limits into the selected generation capacity quantity.

entries.name: Microgrid upward operating-reserve calculator
entries.summary: Identifies the available increase in assigned resource output under the documented reserve definition.

entries.name: Microgrid downward operating-reserve calculator
entries.summary: Identifies the available reduction in assigned resource output or added absorption capacity.

entries.name: Microgrid power-deficit detection block
entries.summary: Compares assigned demand with available supply under the defined island or connected condition.

entries.name: Microgrid power-surplus detection block
entries.summary: Identifies the defined condition in which available generation exceeds the assigned absorption and load capacity.

entries.name: Microgrid active-power ramp limiter
entries.summary: Constrains the rate of change of the assigned dispatch target according to its configured limits.

entries.name: Microgrid resource dispatch saturation flag
entries.summary: Reports that a controlled resource has reached its assigned active-power operating bound.

entries.name: Microgrid dispatch tracking-error monitor
entries.summary: Compares the assigned active-power request with the measured resource response.

entries.name: Microgrid peak-demand support request
entries.summary: Requests the assigned local generation or storage contribution under the documented demand-support strategy.

entries.name: Microgrid renewable-priority allocator
entries.summary: Applies the selected resource priority when allocating a feasible active-power target.

entries.name: Microgrid generator minimum-load restraint
entries.summary: Coordinates dispatch with the documented minimum operating-load constraints of assigned generators.

entries.name: Microgrid resource runback request
entries.summary: Requests the documented reduction of an assigned resource output following its initiating condition.

entries.name: Microgrid active-power control ownership selector
entries.summary: Selects which authorized control function currently determines the assigned power target.
